pre_terminal_observation.consequence: record the deviation transparently; keep cutout selection and all finder execution closed pending named review
pre_terminal_observation.observation: while the final Hydra archive was still downloading, FITS headers and the first five SDC1 truth rows of already complete exact-sized files were inspected before the aggregate acquisition record sealed

proposed_sdc1_selection.admission: arithmetic mean of finite resampled primary-beam values is at least 0.5; any non-finite or out-of-domain sample rejects tile
proposed_sdc1_selection.apparent_flux: truth integrated flux in Jy multiplied by bilinearly interpolated primary-beam response at the truth centroid
proposed_sdc1_selection.apparent_peak_snr: apparent integrated flux times 0.6*0.6 divided by sqrt(converted_b_maj**2+0.6**2)*sqrt(converted_b_min**2+0.6**2), then divided by 73e-9 Jy/beam
proposed_sdc1_selection.candidate_grid: nonoverlapping half-open tiles aligned at x,y multiples of 2048 over the complete 32768-square image
proposed_sdc1_selection.noise_reference: Bonaldi et al. 2021 MNRAS 500 3821 Table 1, 1400-MHz 1000-hour 73-nJy/beam nominal thermal noise
proposed_sdc1_selection.primary_beam_resampling: bilinear interpolation of PrimaryBeam_B2.fits at every SDC1 image-pixel centre through the two recorded celestial WCSs
ranking: ordinary: abs(source_count - median admitted source_count) ascending
proposed_sdc1_selection.tie_break: increasing global tile-core (y_start,x_start); select in stratum order and take the first not already selected

tile_attributes.closest_pair_beams: minimum truth-centroid great-circle separation divided by 0.6 arcsec; infinity for fewer than two sources
tile_attributes.dynamic_range: maximum apparent integrated flux divided by median positive apparent integrated flux; 0 when there is no positive apparent flux
tile_attributes.low_snr_fraction: fraction with apparent peak SNR in the closed interval [5,8]; 0 for an empty tile
tile_attributes.resolved_fraction: fraction with converted Gaussian major FWHM greater than the recorded 0.6-arcsec synthesized beam; 0 for an empty tile
tile_attributes.source_count: number of truth centroids in tile

proposed_sdc1_selection.truth_membership: official ra_cent,dec_cent transformed with the image WCS lies inside the tile half-open pixel bounds

units.b_maj,b_min: arcsecond in size convention named by size
units.class: integer source-population label interpreted only by the official SDC1 response/scoring definition; report-only for Hebog
